info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-Delete Rideshare Rides Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Cancel Rideshare Rides API allows users to effectively manage their rides by canceling scheduled rideshare requests. This endpoint is essential for users who need to modify their transportation plans due to changes in their itinerary or personal circumstances. Typical consumers include rideshare passengers and service providers. By using this API, they can ensure that their scheduling remains flexible and up-to-date, facilitating a better user experience in managing transportation during their travels.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel a ride that they have previously scheduled. Upon cancellation, the ride will no longer be active, and any related charges will be handled according to the policy in effect at the time of cancellation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a ride. It requires specific details about the ride that should be canceled.

200.description: The ride cancellation request was successfully processed.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelRequest.description: The request body for cancelling a ride operation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_200.title: Cancel Ride Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the ride after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the successful cancellation of a ride.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that initiated the cancellation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the cancellation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the audit information associated with the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the processing time for the operation, measured in milliseconds. A value of 0 indicates that the processing was instantaneous.

schema.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
